NSH::path_id
Description
The command gets/sets the path id for NSH.
Syntax
NSH
::
path_id
[
DIRECTION
NSH_PATH_ID
]
Examples
Set the path ID for NSH.
when LB_SELECTED {

NSH::path_id serverside_egress 10

set mypath_id [NSH::path_id]

}
